title: Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination
paragraphs: We reviewed the claim submitted by Northgate Imaging Center under your Medicare Advantage plan for services provided on July 10, 2026. After review, we are unable to approve payment.
Reason for denial: The claim was received after the filing deadline. Claims must be submitted within 90 days of the date of service. Reason code: CO-29.
The plan paid $0.00 of the $1,995.33 billed. The amount you may owe the provider is $1,995.33.

appeal.heading: Your Right to Appeal
appeal.text: You or your authorized representative may file a written appeal within 180 days of the date you receive this notice. Send it to Ostrander Mutual Health, Appeals Unit, PO Box 95188, Erie, PA 16501. If waiting for a standard decision could seriously harm your health, you may ask for an expedited appeal by calling 1-800-555-5233.
appeal.external: After the internal appeal, you may have the right to an independent external review. Free help is available from your state's consumer assistance program.
